summary: Truist Financial Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to offer 500,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/25th interest in a share of 6.250% Series S Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a liquidation preference of $1,000 per depositary share. The offering is a routine capital-raising via preferred stock, with an underwriting discount of $10 per share and proceeds of $990 per share to Truist. Dividends are fixed at 6.250% through June 15, 2031, then reset at five-year Treasury plus 2.129%. The shares are not listed on any exchange. No special situation event is present.
